grants.label: Litany of Endurance
grants.scope: Fortitude saves against effects that cause Fatigued or arise from environmental hardship

effects.text: The suppression is for penalties only; Fatigued is not reduced, and the penalties return on leaving the area.

warps.text: Affected creatures cannot have their Fatigued condition increased above its current value while within the area

system.description:
AUDITORY ENCHANTMENT UTILITY
Tradition divinity
Cast 2 AP (verbal)
Area 30-foot emanation
Duration 1 minute

You recite a measured litany of perseverance, strengthening those who hear you against exhaustion and hardship.
You and willing allies within the area gain a +2-status bonus to Fortitude saving throws against effects that cause Fatigued or arise from environmental hardship.
Furthermore, affected creatures treat their Fatigued condition as 1 lower for the purpose of determining its penalties. This does not actually reduce or remove Fatigued. If a creature leaves the area, its normal penalties immediately return.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the emanation by 10 feet.
+4 PP: Affected creatures cannot have their Fatigued condition increased above its current value while within the area.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The +2 status to Fortitude is a scoped row on you and your allies; Fatigued is suppressed by 1 for its penalties.
